_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: AAT Level 2 Certificate in Accounting qualification specification (Qualification Number 603/6338/1), Version 5.6, published September 2026
_items_source.version: Version 5.6 (published 1 September 2026), the current version linked from aat.org.uk/deliver/qualifications/specifications-outlines, itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: AAT's own scope-of-content numbering, which restarts at 1 for each of the four units. This course prefixes each reference with the unit's initials to keep every code unique across the qualification: IB (Introduction to Bookkeeping), PBC (Principles of Bookkeeping Controls), PC (Principles of Costing), BE (The Business Environment) -- e.g. IB2.1 is AAT's own topic 2.1 within Introduction to Bookkeeping's learning outcome 2.
